name: bin
concept: the binary under test: a path, or the name of a program on PATH

name: contract
concept: a minor of the atip/1 contract

name: error
concept: a code of atip's error registry

name: fixture
concept: the fixture file of the tool under test

name: jobs
concept: how many invocations of a deep run run at once

name: level
concept: a conformance level of the contract

name: path
concept: the words of a command path of atip's tree

name: warning
concept: a code of atip's warning registry
